officialInput.name: uBlock Origin (full Firefox build, NOT Lite)
officialInput.scope: Official package parsing only. Separate fixture tests native request cancellation. No full uBO execution/compatibility claim.
officialInput.license: GPL-3.0; package is downloaded from upstream during CI, not modified or checked into this repository. Renaming to .zip preserves all package bytes.

reasons: WebKit native API functions require their original receiver; forwarding to the real API fixes binding without synthesizing any missing capability.
Use real native tab creation events when webNavigation lacks the target event. Opener frame identity is unavailable and explicitly not invented or claimed equivalent.
Map cache/rule-change notification onto real compilation and atomic native DNR replacement, not a fake webRequest method. Only user-filter rules are bridged at this milestone.
WebKit throws on an empty message name; retain empty UI labels without suppressing real translation/API errors for nonempty names.
Cooperative timer-based idle fallback executes real scheduled work when native requestIdleCallback is absent. Not a native idle-time or performance claim.
Use the same real tab-event platform adapter in the original scriptlet engine; source-frame attribution limitations remain explicit.
